scope.caveat: Both implementation heads are open PRs. “Reflected” means present at the inspected immutable head, not merged or deployed to production.

spec_statuses.contradicts: v3.4 makes the opposite final decision.
spec_statuses.not_in_spec: No matching normative requirement was found in v3.4.

implementation_statuses.reflected: Requirement is visible/supported at the inspected PR head.
implementation_statuses.partial: Some required behavior exists; material portions are absent or risky.
implementation_statuses.not_reflected: No implementation of the requirement was found at the inspected PR head.
implementation_statuses.intentionally_not_implemented: Alternative is absent consistently with a final spec rejection/future decision.
implementation_statuses.not_applicable: No meaningful acceptance criterion exists in that layer.

methodology.screenshot_method: The exact frontend head was run with Vite against a deterministic read-only fixture API. Desktop and mobile routes were captured with agent-browser; screenshots prove visible state, not production deployment.
methodology.backend_method: The exact backend head and its stacked PR #4 were inspected. GitHub CI is green, but Bazel/Swift were unavailable locally. Open PR review blockers are preserved below.

console_findings: Builder model Select changes from uncontrolled to controlled after async model loading (Base UI console error).

backend.local_execution: not run: Bazel and Swift toolchains were unavailable

review_findings.title: Deployed beta gate may be impossible
review_findings.detail: PR #5 changes the code default to 1, but the reviewed beta environment remains PVE_REQUIRED_WINS=3 while most scenarios expose only two presets per side.

review_findings.title: Dispatch reservation leak
review_findings.detail: Best-effort compensation can leave an unbound reservation that permanently consumes an in-flight concurrency slot.

review_findings.title: Orphan match after enqueue failure
review_findings.detail: A match row can survive while quota compensation removes its reservation, allowing later execution without metering.

review_findings.title: Prompt limit is bypassable
review_findings.detail: The counter covers CJK ideographs and ASCII word runs only; kana, Hangul, Cyrillic, emoji, punctuation, and long unbroken ASCII can evade the intended 1000-unit limit, and mutate has no limit.
